note: band = where Higher-tier questions on this topic usually sit (4-5, 6, 7, 8-9). Rough guide for ordering study, not an AQA classification.

strands.R: Ratio, proportion and rates of change

topics.name: Ordering numbers and inequality symbols
topics.spec: Order positive and negative integers, decimals and fractions; use the symbols =, ≠, <, >, ≤, ≥.

topics.name: Four operations incl. fractions and negatives
topics.spec: Apply the four operations, including formal written methods, to integers, decimals and simple fractions (proper and improper), and mixed numbers, all both positive and negative; understand and use place value.

topics.name: Inverse operations and order of operations
topics.spec: Recognise and use relationships between operations, including inverse operations; use conventional notation for priority of operations, including brackets, powers, roots and reciprocals.

topics.name: Primes, factors, HCF, LCM, prime factorisation
topics.spec: Use the concepts and vocabulary of prime numbers, factors, multiples, common factors, common multiples, HCF, LCM, prime factorisation, including using product notation and the unique factorisation theorem.

topics.name: Systematic listing and product rule for counting
topics.spec: Apply systematic listing strategies, including use of the product rule for counting.

topics.name: Powers and roots, estimating them
topics.spec: Use positive integer powers and associated real roots (square, cube and higher), recognise powers of 2, 3, 4, 5; estimate powers and roots of any given positive number.

topics.name: Negative and fractional indices
topics.spec: Calculate with roots, and with integer and fractional indices.

topics.name: Exact calculation: surds, π, rationalising
topics.spec: Calculate exactly with fractions, surds and multiples of π; simplify surd expressions involving squares and rationalise denominators.

topics.name: Standard form
topics.spec: Calculate with and interpret standard form A × 10^n, where 1 ≤ A < 10 and n is an integer.

topics.name: Recurring decimals and fractions
topics.spec: Work interchangeably with terminating decimals and their corresponding fractions; change recurring decimals into their corresponding fractions and vice versa.

topics.name: Fractions in ratio problems
topics.spec: Identify and work with fractions in ratio problems.

topics.name: Fractions and percentages as operators
topics.spec: Interpret fractions and percentages as operators.

topics.name: Standard units and measures
topics.spec: Use standard units of mass, length, time, money and other measures (including standard compound measures) using decimal quantities where appropriate.

topics.name: Estimation and checking
topics.spec: Estimate answers; check calculations using approximation and estimation, including answers obtained using technology.

topics.name: Rounding and error intervals
topics.spec: Round numbers and measures to an appropriate degree of accuracy; use inequality notation to specify simple error intervals due to truncation or rounding.

topics.name: Upper and lower bounds
topics.spec: Apply and interpret limits of accuracy, including upper and lower bounds.

topics.name: Algebraic notation
topics.spec: Use and interpret algebraic notation.

topics.name: Substitution into formulae
topics.spec: Substitute numerical values into formulae and expressions, including scientific formulae.

topics.name: Expressions, equations, formulae, identities
topics.spec: Understand and use the concepts and vocabulary of expressions, equations, formulae, identities, inequalities, terms and factors.

topics.name: Expanding, factorising, algebraic fractions, index laws
topics.spec: Simplify and manipulate algebraic expressions (including those involving surds and algebraic fractions): collect like terms, expand products of two or more binomials, factorise quadratics including ax² + bx + c and difference of two squares, simplify using the laws of indices.

topics.name: Rearranging formulae (change the subject)
topics.spec: Understand and use standard mathematical formulae; rearrange formulae to change the subject.

topics.name: Algebraic proof and identities
topics.spec: Know the difference between an equation and an identity; argue mathematically to show algebraic expressions are equivalent, and use algebra to support and construct arguments and proofs.

topics.name: Functions: inverse and composite
topics.spec: Interpret simple expressions as functions with inputs and outputs; interpret the reverse process as the inverse function; interpret the succession of two functions as a composite function.

topics.name: Coordinates in four quadrants
topics.spec: Work with coordinates in all four quadrants.

topics.name: Straight-line graphs, parallel and perpendicular
topics.spec: Plot straight-line graphs; use y = mx + c to identify parallel and perpendicular lines; find the equation of the line through two given points, or through one point with a given gradient.

topics.name: Gradients and intercepts
topics.spec: Identify and interpret gradients and intercepts of linear functions graphically and algebraically.

topics.name: Quadratic graphs: roots, turning points, completing the square
topics.spec: Identify and interpret roots, intercepts, turning points of quadratic functions graphically; deduce roots algebraically and turning points by completing the square.

topics.name: Recognising and sketching graphs (cubic, reciprocal, exponential, trig)
topics.spec: Recognise, sketch and interpret graphs of linear, quadratic, simple cubic, reciprocal y = 1/x, exponential y = k^x, and trigonometric functions for angles of any size.

topics.name: Transformations of graphs
topics.spec: Sketch translations and reflections of a given function.

topics.name: Real-life and non-standard graphs
topics.spec: Plot and interpret graphs (including reciprocal and exponential graphs) and graphs of non-standard functions in real contexts, including simple kinematic problems.

topics.name: Gradients of curves and areas under graphs
topics.spec: Calculate or estimate gradients of graphs and areas under graphs (including non-linear graphs), and interpret results in contexts such as distance-time, velocity-time and financial graphs.

topics.name: Equation of a circle and tangent
topics.spec: Recognise and use the equation of a circle with centre at the origin; find the equation of a tangent to a circle at a given point.

topics.name: Linear equations
topics.spec: Solve linear equations in one unknown algebraically (including unknowns on both sides); find approximate solutions using a graph.

topics.name: Quadratic equations (factorise, formula, completing the square)
topics.spec: Solve quadratic equations (including those that require rearrangement) algebraically by factorising, by completing the square and by using the quadratic formula; find approximate solutions using a graph.

topics.name: Simultaneous equations (linear and linear/quadratic)
topics.spec: Solve two simultaneous equations in two variables (linear/linear or linear/quadratic) algebraically; find approximate solutions using a graph.

topics.name: Iteration
topics.spec: Find approximate solutions to equations numerically using iteration.

topics.name: Forming and solving equations from context
topics.spec: Translate simple situations or procedures into algebraic expressions or formulae; derive an equation (or two simultaneous equations), solve and interpret the solution.

topics.name: Inequalities (linear, quadratic, regions)
topics.spec: Solve linear inequalities in one or two variables, and quadratic inequalities in one variable; represent the solution set on a number line, using set notation and on a graph.

topics.name: Generating sequences
topics.spec: Generate terms of a sequence from either a term-to-term or a position-to-term rule.

topics.name: Special sequences (geometric, quadratic, Fibonacci)
topics.spec: Recognise and use sequences of triangular, square and cube numbers, arithmetic progressions, Fibonacci-type sequences, quadratic sequences, and simple geometric progressions.

topics.name: nth term (linear and quadratic)
topics.spec: Deduce expressions to calculate the nth term of linear and quadratic sequences.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Converting units incl. area/volume and compound units
topics.spec: Change freely between related standard units and compound units in numerical and algebraic contexts.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Scale factors, scale diagrams and maps
topics.spec: Use scale factors, scale diagrams and maps.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: One quantity as a fraction of another
topics.spec: Express one quantity as a fraction of another.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Ratio notation and simplifying
topics.spec: Use ratio notation, including reduction to simplest form.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Sharing in a ratio and ratio problems
topics.spec: Divide a quantity in a given part:part or part:whole ratio; express a division as a ratio; apply ratio to real contexts and problems.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Multiplicative relationships as ratios
topics.spec: Express a multiplicative relationship between two quantities as a ratio or a fraction.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Proportion as equality of ratios
topics.spec: Understand and use proportion as equality of ratios.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Ratios, fractions and linear functions
topics.spec: Relate ratios to fractions and to linear functions.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Percentages incl. reverse percentages
topics.spec: Percentages and percentage change, including increase/decrease, original value problems and simple interest in financial mathematics.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Direct and inverse proportion problems
topics.spec: Solve problems involving direct and inverse proportion, including graphical and algebraic representations.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Compound units: speed, density, pressure
topics.spec: Use compound units such as speed, rates of pay, unit pricing, density and pressure.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Comparing lengths, areas, volumes; similarity links
topics.spec: Compare lengths, areas and volumes using ratio notation; make links to similarity (including trigonometric ratios) and scale factors.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Proportion equations (y = kx, y = k/x²)
topics.spec: Understand that X is inversely proportional to Y is equivalent to X is proportional to 1/Y; construct and interpret equations that describe direct and inverse proportion.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Gradient as rate of change; proportion graphs
topics.spec: Interpret the gradient of a straight-line graph as a rate of change; recognise and interpret graphs that illustrate direct and inverse proportion.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Instantaneous and average rate of change
topics.spec: Interpret the gradient at a point on a curve as the instantaneous rate of change; apply average and instantaneous rate of change in numerical, algebraic and graphical contexts.

topics.strand: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
topics.name: Growth, decay, compound interest
topics.spec: Set up, solve and interpret growth and decay problems, including compound interest, and work with general iterative processes.

topics.name: Geometric notation and conventions
topics.spec: Use conventional terms and notations for points, lines, polygons and symmetry; label sides and angles of triangles; draw diagrams from written descriptions.

topics.name: Constructions and loci
topics.spec: Use the standard ruler and compass constructions; construct figures and solve loci problems.

topics.name: Angle facts, parallel lines, polygons
topics.spec: Angles at a point, on a straight line, vertically opposite, alternate and corresponding angles; angle sums in triangles and polygons; properties of regular polygons.

topics.name: Properties of quadrilaterals and triangles
topics.spec: Derive and apply properties of special quadrilaterals and triangles.

topics.name: Congruence criteria (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS)
topics.spec: Use the basic congruence criteria for triangles (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS).

topics.name: Geometric reasoning and proof
topics.spec: Apply angle facts, congruence, similarity and properties of quadrilaterals to derive results, including Pythagoras' theorem, and construct simple proofs.

topics.name: Transformations incl. negative and fractional enlargement
topics.spec: Identify, describe and construct congruent and similar shapes by rotation, reflection, translation and enlargement (including fractional and negative scale factors).

topics.name: Combined transformations and invariance
topics.spec: Describe the changes and invariance achieved by combinations of rotations, reflections and translations.

topics.name: Circle vocabulary
topics.spec: Identify and apply circle definitions and properties: centre, radius, chord, diameter, circumference, tangent, arc, sector and segment.

topics.name: Circle theorems
topics.spec: Apply and prove the standard circle theorems concerning angles, radii, tangents and chords.

topics.name: Geometry problems on coordinate axes
topics.spec: Solve geometrical problems on coordinate axes.

topics.name: Properties of 3D shapes
topics.spec: Identify properties of faces, surfaces, edges and vertices of cubes, cuboids, prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones and spheres.

topics.name: Plans and elevations
topics.spec: Construct and interpret plans and elevations of 3D shapes.

topics.name: Units of measure
topics.spec: Use standard units of measure and related concepts.

topics.name: Measuring, scale drawings, bearings
topics.spec: Measure line segments and angles, interpret maps and scale drawings, and use bearings.

topics.name: Area and volume of 2D shapes and prisms
topics.spec: Area of triangles, parallelograms, trapezia; volume of cuboids and other right prisms (including cylinders).

topics.name: Circles, spheres, cones, pyramids: area, surface area, volume
topics.spec: Perimeter and area of circles and composite shapes; surface area and volume of spheres, pyramids, cones and composite solids.

topics.name: Arc length and sector area
topics.spec: Calculate arc lengths, angles and areas of sectors of circles.

topics.name: Similarity: lengths, areas and volumes
topics.spec: Apply congruence and similarity, including the relationships between lengths, areas and volumes in similar figures.

topics.name: Pythagoras and right-angled trig (incl. 3D)
topics.spec: Pythagoras' theorem and the trigonometric ratios in right-angled triangles, in two and three dimensions.

topics.name: Exact trig values
topics.spec: Know the exact values of sin and cos for 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90° and tan for 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°.

topics.name: Sine rule and cosine rule
topics.spec: Know and apply the sine rule and cosine rule to find unknown lengths and angles.

topics.name: Area = ½ab sin C
topics.spec: Know and apply Area = ½ab sin C.

topics.name: Vectors: translations and column vectors
topics.spec: Describe translations as 2D vectors.

topics.name: Vector arithmetic and vector proof
topics.spec: Add and subtract vectors, multiply by a scalar; use vectors to construct geometric arguments and proofs.

topics.name: Frequency trees and experimental outcomes
topics.spec: Record, describe and analyse outcomes of probability experiments using tables and frequency trees.

topics.name: Expected outcomes
topics.spec: Apply ideas of randomness, fairness and equally likely events to calculate expected outcomes.

topics.name: Relative frequency and theoretical probability
topics.spec: Relate relative expected frequencies to theoretical probability, using the 0–1 probability scale.

topics.name: Probabilities sum to 1
topics.spec: Probabilities of an exhaustive set of mutually exclusive outcomes sum to one.

topics.name: Sample size and reliability
topics.spec: Understand that empirical unbiased samples tend towards theoretical distributions with increasing sample size.

topics.name: Sets, Venn diagrams, systematic enumeration
topics.spec: Enumerate sets and combinations of sets systematically, using tables, grids, Venn diagrams and tree diagrams.

topics.name: Sample spaces
topics.spec: Construct theoretical possibility spaces for single and combined experiments with equally likely outcomes.

topics.name: Combined events and tree diagrams (independent/dependent)
topics.spec: Calculate the probability of independent and dependent combined events, including using tree diagrams.

topics.name: Conditional probability
topics.spec: Calculate and interpret conditional probabilities using two-way tables, tree diagrams and Venn diagrams.

topics.name: Sampling and populations
topics.spec: Infer properties of populations or distributions from a sample, knowing the limitations of sampling.

topics.name: Charts, tables, time series, pie charts
topics.spec: Interpret and construct tables, charts and diagrams for categorical and discrete data, and line graphs for time series.

topics.name: Histograms and cumulative frequency
topics.spec: Construct and interpret histograms with equal and unequal class intervals and cumulative frequency graphs.

topics.name: Averages, spread, box plots, comparing distributions
topics.spec: Interpret and compare distributions using graphical representations including box plots, measures of central tendency and spread (range, quartiles and IQR).

topics.name: Using statistics to describe a population
topics.spec: Apply statistics to describe a population.

topics.name: Scatter graphs and correlation
topics.spec: Use and interpret scatter graphs; recognise correlation and that it does not indicate causation; lines of best fit; interpolate and extrapolate.
